ref_text: GOD AS A DIRECT CONSEQUENCE OF THE SIN WHICH MAN THUS PUNISHED HAD GIVEN HER A LOVELY CHILD WHOSE PLACE WAS ON THAT SAME DISHONOURED BOSOM TO CONNECT HER PARENT FOR EVER WITH THE RACE AND DESCENT OF MORTALS AND TO BE FINALLY A BLESSED SOUL IN HEAVEN
text: God, as a direct consequence of the sin which man thus punished, had given her a lovely child whose place was on that same dishonored bosom to connect her parrot forever with the race and descent of mortals, and to be finally a blessed soul in heaven.
